info.title: KF Inventory API
info.description: The JSON API behind the React UI.

post.summary:
{"username", "password", "remember_me"?}: the session starts and the answer is who signed in. 401
invalid_credentials for a wrong username or password.

get.summary: Who is signed in. 401 when nobody is.
Every user, by name. (item 1)

post.summary: UserInput: creates a user. 422 when invalid. (item 1)

get.summary: One user. 404 user_not_found. (item 1)

put.summary: UserInput: edits a user; a blank password keeps the current one. (item 1)

get.summary: A product by its code (the barcode reader). 404 product_not_found. (item 2)
A product by uuid. 404 product_not_found. (item 2)

post.summary: multipart: `file` (xls/xlsx, the template's columns) and `warehouse_id`. 415 unsupported_media; 422 invalid_spreadsheet. (item 2)

get.summary: The stock spreadsheet: `all=1` for every product, or `uuid[]=…` for the selected ones (an xls attachment). (item 2)
The warehouse's stock rows with `status` (1 in stock, default; 0 incoming). (item 2)

post.summary: StockLinesInput: moves quantities to another warehouse (they arrive as incoming). 204; 409 same_warehouse; 404 stock_not_found; 422 insufficient_stock. (item 2)
StockLinesInput (by code): the barcode reader adds stock. 204. (item 2)
StockLinesInput (by code): the barcode reader removes stock. 204; 422 insufficient_stock. (item 2)
Approves every incoming row of the warehouse. (item 2)

get.summary: Every warehouse (as /admin/warehouse/all: any signed-in user). (item 2)

put.summary: WarehouseInput: renames a warehouse (as the legacy edit: any signed-in user). (item 2)

get.summary: `page` (1…), `per_page` (100 by default, as before). (item 3)
Every customer, for the order and invoice pickers. (item 3)
One customer. 404 customer_not_found. (item 3)

put.summary: CustomerInput: edits a customer and replaces their addresses. (item 3)

delete.summary: Deletes a customer (soft delete, as before). 204. (item 3)

get.summary: Every country with its states and their cities. (item 3)
`warehouse_id`: that warehouse's orders, newest first. (item 4)

post.summary: OrderInput: places an order; the printer gets its email. 422 order_without_products. (item 4)

get.summary: One order. 404 order_not_found. (item 4)

delete.summary: Deletes an order (its products and comments, then the order: soft delete). 204. (item 4)

post.summary: OrderStatusInput: moves the order to another status. (item 4)

put.summary: OrderCommentsInput: the order's comments as they should be (as before: any signed-in user). (item 4)

post.summary: Pulls new orders from the WooCommerce shops (item 13). 501 order_sync_unavailable until then; 502 order_sync_failed. (item 13)

get.summary: The order as a PDF (the printer's). (item 4)
What is left to ship, as a PDF. (item 4)
The order as a spreadsheet (as before: any signed-in user). (item 4)
What was shipped, what is left, and the stock (as before: any signed-in user). (item 4)

post.summary: PartialInput: records a partial shipment. 409 partial_exceeds_order. (item 4)

get.summary: Every invoice, newest first. (item 5)
The code the next invoice is offered. (item 5)
One invoice. 404 invoice_not_found. (item 5)
The invoice as a PDF. (item 5)
